title: Progress on Disability Sports Master Plan
what_it_is: Progress on Disability Sports Master Plan

sections.label: Disability Sport Master Plan launch
sections.summary: SportSG launched the Disability Sport Master Plan in May 2016 to improve sport access and opportunities for persons with disabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Sport Singapore's (SportSG's) Disability Sport Master Plan (DSMP) was launched in May 2016 to improve access and opportunities for persons with disabilities to discover the value of sport and lead an active lifestyle, develop Singapore's capabilities in para sports as well as raise the profile of Team Singapore para athletes with Singaporeans.

sections.label: Centres, gyms and programmes
sections.summary: SportSG set up four Centres of Expertise, opened seven inclusive gyms and introduced disability sport programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: SportSG has set up four Centres of Expertise in Bedok, Jurong West, Sengkang and Toa Payoh, opened seven inclusive gyms and introduced a range of disability sport programmes.

sections.label: Participation growth and outreach events
sections.summary: ISF and outreach events engaged over 11,000 participants with disabilities and close to 90,000 others, with participation rising from 28% in 2015 to 51% in 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Altogether, ISF and other awareness and outreach events have engaged more than 11,000 participants with disabilities and close to 90,000 others in the last three years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: In sports, such as archery and canoe sprint, participants competed in inclusive teams comprising persons with and without disabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: We are encouraged by the growth in sports participation amongst persons with disabilities from 28% in 2015 to 51% in 2018, based on SportSG's annual National Sports Participation Survey.

sections.label: Para athletes among spexScholars
sections.summary: Of the current 72 spexScholars, 10 are para athletes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: Amongst our current crop of 72 spexScholars, 10 are para athletes.

sections.label: Training completed and Vision 2030 report
sections.summary: Close to 500 coaches, 300 SportSG staff and 1,600 volunteers completed courses, and SportSG published its DSMP progress in its Vision 2030 mid-term report.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: To date, close to 500 coaches, 300 SportSG staff and 1,600 volunteers have completed relevant courses to support disability sport programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: In August this year, SportSG reviewed its progress in DSMP and published this as part of its Vision 2030 mid-term report.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Culture, Community and Youth)
sentences.text: SportSG stated in its report that it will broaden its range of partnerships to include corporations and organisations to form "Communities of Care" that can serve the community in impactful ways, such as by supporting the DSMP and promoting social inclusion through sport.
